== Overview ==

Dear Players, following today's server save, we have fixed an issue affecting Portal Bosses phase scaling, which could in certain situations cause bosses to deal more damage than intended as encounters progressed through later phases. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.

Players searching for '''Shadow Illusion''' usually want the official website, client download path, rules, rates, and whether the world is still active. See:
